extension.description: Stellt parallele Multi-Site-Suche, lokales HLS/MP4-Stream-Relaying, dynamische Player-Auswertung und ausfallsichere DNS-Auflösung für AdultHideout bereit.
Provides native high-concurrency search, local HLS/MP4 stream relaying, dynamic JavaScript player evaluation, and resilient DNS resolution for AdultHideout.
Fournit une recherche parallèle haute concurrence, un relais local de flux HLS/MP4, une évaluation JavaScript dynamique et une résolution DNS résiliente pour AdultHideout.
Proporciona búsqueda paralela de alta concurrencia, retransmisión local de flujos HLS/MP4, evaluación dinámica de JavaScript y resolución DNS resiliente para AdultHideout.
Fornisce ricerca parallela ad alta concorrenza, relay locale di flussi HLS/MP4, valutazione dinamica JavaScript e risoluzione DNS resiliente per AdultHideout.
extension.news:
v. 1.0.2 - 2026-11-11 - Core engine now on 32-bit ARM Linux: CoreELEC, LibreELEC and Raspberry Pi systems with 32-bit Kodi get the full native Core search; smarter, calmer engine start.
v. 1.0.1 - 2026-11-09 - New Core engine: native single-pass search across all sources, smarter result recognition for site APIs, feeds and search forms, cleaner results and a streamlined network layer, freshly built for all seven platforms.
v. 1.0.0 - 2026-11-03 - First release of the native AdultHideout Core engine for concurrent search, stream relaying and script evaluation. - Detects the device platform, downloads only the matching binary (~3 MB) after confirmation and starts it without restarting Kodi.
